purpose: Additive source/access/requirement/crosswalk data for direct-source IEEE review and SDOS runtime-governance intake. Crosswalks remain derivative and cannot assert source wording or Caelestis conformity.

ieee_7009_annex_a3.summary: Incorporate functions according to the standard's designated safety categories.
applicability_conditions: Applies when the ASOI is capable of exhibiting the standard's Distinguishing Characteristics.

ieee_7009_annex_a3.summary: Provide means to inhibit execution of an individual safety-related function.
